name: Lush Receipt
description: This receipt is issued by LUSH Fresh Handmade Cosmetics, with the LUSH brand logo and tagline (“Fresh Handmade Cosmetics”) displayed prominently at the top. The receipt identifies the store location as Oxford Retail, followed by a section labeled “In Your Basket” that lists the items included in the transaction. The financial summary shows the quantity of items sold, total amount due, and a breakdown including net amount, tax, and total paid. The payment section records the card payment with masked card digits, along with reference number, payment service provider (PSP) identifier, and application identifier (AID) associated with the card processing terminal. Additional lines show discount reductions applied to the purchase and a “Bring It Back” incentive entry. The lower portion includes a barcode with transaction reference digits, followed by promotional messaging encouraging customers to download the LushLabs app and leave a review of their store experience.
